name: arrow-left
description: Represents moving back or pointing left. On hover the arrow nudges leftward, pointing the way.

animation.description: Shaft and head translate -3.5px on x and return (0.3s easeOut) — a pointing nudge in the direction of travel. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context when used as a back-navigation control.
